title_en: Spring 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program: Application Deadline Extended to October 29
summary: Currently enrolled undergraduate students in years 2 to 4 who wish to take part in the College of Engineering's 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program, held during the winter vacation from 15 December 2026 to 8 February 2027, may apply. Applicants must first confirm participation with a lab listed in Attachment 2, then submit the original application and recommendation form, signed by the lab's professor, together with a safety and environment training certificate. Documents must be submitted to Building 301, Room 319 by 18:00 on Thursday, 29 October.
applies_to: Optional application, open to currently enrolled undergraduate students in years 2 to 4 who can participate for at least 10 hours per week and who are able to complete the Fall 2026 safety and environment training. Students who expect a change in academic status, such as a leave of absence or withdrawal, are excluded. The department has 13 places.

translation:
2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program: Application Guide (application period extended; deadline 29 October)

The Seoul National University College of Engineering is running the "2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program" to give undergraduate students the opportunity to experience real research settings. Interested undergraduate students are invited to apply according to the notice below.

1. Details
(1) Research internship period: (during vacation) Tuesday, 15 December 2026 to Monday, 8 February 2027, 8 weeks
(2) Research internship stipend: KRW 800,000 per student (KRW 400,000 × 2 months)
(3) Eligibility: currently enrolled undergraduate students in years 2 to 4
 - Participation of at least 10 hours per week is mandatory. Students who expect a change in academic status, such as a leave of absence or withdrawal, are excluded.
 - Applicants must be able to complete the Fall 2026 safety and environment training.
 ※ Undergraduates can check their own training completion status through the SAFE system (신입생연구안전통합정보시스템); students with earlier student numbers should check with the department office.

2. Application Method and Selection Criteria
(1) Deadline and method: submit the originals of the documents below (Undergraduate Research Internship Application and Recommendation Form, and safety and environment training completion certificate) to the department office in Building 301, Room 319 by 18:00 on Thursday, 29 October.
 - [Form 1] Undergraduate Research Internship Application and Recommendation Form (학부생 연구인턴십 지원신청 및 추천서), included in [Attachment 1]
 -> Contact the teaching assistant of the lab you wish to join among the labs listed in [Attachment 2] 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program Research Projects, confirm whether you can participate, write your participation plan, obtain the signature of the participating lab's professor, and submit.
 - One copy of the safety and environment training completion certificate (for students admitted in 2024 or earlier, the department will check completion; if the certificate cannot be printed, it need not be submitted).
 ※ Apply after carefully reading the support plan in [Attachment 1] for deadlines and details.
 ※ Our department has been allocated 13 places; if there are many applicants, selection will be made according to the department's selection rules.

3. Points to Note for Participants
- Participate in research only after full training on research activities (laboratory precautions, how to use equipment, etc.) has been given.
- Participants must write and submit a result report using [Form 2] (contents: summary of research participation, tasks performed, expected outcomes, etc.).
- Participants must complete and submit the research internship undergraduate attendance sheet using [Form 3].
- Cancellation after selection is not possible, so please consider carefully before applying.

4. Inquiries: the department office (the contact details are in the original notice).
